fields.description: Program Description Requirements for Chinese Level Generally students are required to pass HSK 6 before studying at BIPT except for the following: Chinese language students do not have to pass HSK. After the test for their Chinese level given by BIPT, they will start at the appropriate level. For some programs taught in English, students do not have to pass HSK. With application visiting students do not have to meet the requirements for Chinese level or pass HSK. Instead, they are required to have a good knowledge of English. Application for Chinese Government Scholarship The application will be submitted to the local agency or institution in charge of student dispatch or to the local Chinese embassy. The application period is from January to April every year. Duration of Study and Certificate An academic year is divided into three semesters: autumn semester( from early September to the next mid January),spring semester (from mid February to late June) and summer (from July to August).In summer semester students have field practice and short-term language training courses. The duration of study generally ranges from 1 semester to 2 academic years. Students will be issued a certificate for the course of study and will not be granted a degree, provided that they have passed all the issued a certificate for the course of study or will drop out of school. Chinese Teaching Long-term (form six months to one year) basic Chinese and pragmatic Chinese courses (including oral Chinese, listening, grammar and reading and writing) are given at BIPT in spring or autumn semester. Students will start at the appropriate level (primary, junior or senior).Besides, some elective courses are available, such as Chinese handwriting, ancient Chinese, appreciation of Chinese opera and movie, Chinese boxing, guidance in HSK, etc.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. Two white-background recent photos (bareheaded) * 2. A photocopy of the passport * 3. Resume Written in Chinese or English Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. The applicant must be a non-Chinese citizen who has reached the age of eighteen and holds a valid passport. Applicants must abide by the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China and have no criminal record. 2. Applicants must be in good health.
